name: Stimpak: Super
blurb: How to obtain Stimpak: Super — crafting recipe, ingredients, vendors and any world sources. Directions and photos are added by hand.

creatures.note: Around 976 creatures can drop Stimpak: Super as generic loot; they are not listed individually. See the Containers expand for the per-container drop rates and How to Obtain for the crafting recipe.

consumption.note: Stimpak: Super is a chem consumable. It grants no timed stat buff on its own.
